extracted.subtask_description: A navigational listing of the sections in 5 U.S.C. Subchapter II (the Administrative Procedure Act), showing the statutory headings for rulemaking, adjudications, records, hearings, and related procedural topics. Useful as a quick reference to the topics covered by the APA though the full statutory text is not included on this page.
